description: The 'Best Configuration' described literally in KEY_FINDINGS.md (the layer-by-layer experimental verdict doc). No standalone config existed for it, so this wrapper was created for the champion gauntlet. It combines ONLY the explicitly-listed winning ingredients: random rollout, cutoff depth 5, minimax backup alpha 0.25, ML-calibrated state-eval weights, RAVE k=1000, root 2-worker parallelization, and adaptive rollout depth. It deliberately OMITS progressive widening (champion_minimal adds that on top), so the gauntlet's key_findings_best vs champion_minimal head-to-head measures whether progressive widening earns its place on the validated stack. Same 500 ms / 0.5 iter-per-ms budget as the other candidates for an apples-to-apples comparison.
